```sql
SELECT 
    sum(
        CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN o.items_subtotal - o.discount_total
            ELSE (o.items_subtotal - o.discount_total) * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
        END
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' 
  AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
  AND o.order_status != 'CANCELLED'
  AND o.region_code LIKE 'AU%'
```
